definitions.name: Intercom Get Contact
definitions.documentation: Intercom API 2.14 GET /contacts/:id. Fixed documented regional HTTPS hosts, region US/EU/AU. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection; profile.config merges with node config; bearer token comes from profile.credentials.accessToken or protected INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. Required numeric $retries=0. One dispatch and one bounded page; cursor/page follow-up is explicit. Never retry uncertain writes. Known-field projection preserves optional/null/falsy values; resource IDs are opaque strings, numeric related admin IDs remain documented safe integers. Dot-only or ambiguous percent route fragments reject before credentials. Limits:100 results,100 nested items,100 custom attributes,256KiB request,1MiB response,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30,100000 values,total100–30000ms starting before profile/secrets and covering transport/decode/projection/cleanup. Fatal UTF8 and valid UTF16; no arbitrary endpoints/HTTP proxy, OAuth exchange/refresh, automatic pagination/retries, attachments, listeners, destructive deletes/merges or provider calls at build time. Provider scopes, workspace access, plans, valid identifiers and relationships remain prerequisites. URLs in metadata are never fetched. definitions.name: Intercom List Companies
definitions.documentation: Intercom API 2.14 POST /companies/list. Fixed documented regional HTTPS hosts, region US/EU/AU. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection; profile.config merges with node config; bearer token comes from profile.credentials.accessToken or protected INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. Required numeric $retries=0. One dispatch and one bounded page; cursor/page follow-up is explicit. Never retry uncertain writes. Known-field projection preserves optional/null/falsy values; resource IDs are opaque strings, numeric related admin IDs remain documented safe integers. Dot-only or ambiguous percent route fragments reject before credentials. Limits:100 results,100 nested items,100 custom attributes,256KiB request,1MiB response,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30,100000 values,total100–30000ms starting before profile/secrets and covering transport/decode/projection/cleanup. Fatal UTF8 and valid UTF16; no arbitrary endpoints/HTTP proxy, OAuth exchange/refresh, automatic pagination/retries, attachments, listeners, destructive deletes/merges or provider calls at build time. Provider scopes, workspace access, plans, valid identifiers and relationships remain prerequisites. URLs in metadata are never fetched. definitions.name: Intercom Create Contact
definitions.documentation: Intercom API 2.14 POST /contacts. Fixed documented regional HTTPS hosts, region US/EU/AU. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection; profile.config merges with node config; bearer token comes from profile.credentials.accessToken or protected INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. Required numeric $retries=0. Requires request.confirmMutation=true. One dispatch and one bounded page; cursor/page follow-up is explicit. Never retry uncertain writes. Known-field projection preserves optional/null/falsy values; resource IDs are opaque strings, numeric related admin IDs remain documented safe integers. Dot-only or ambiguous percent route fragments reject before credentials. Limits:100 results,100 nested items,100 custom attributes,256KiB request,1MiB response,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30,100000 values,total100–30000ms starting before profile/secrets and covering transport/decode/projection/cleanup. Fatal UTF8 and valid UTF16; no arbitrary endpoints/HTTP proxy, OAuth exchange/refresh, automatic pagination/retries, attachments, listeners, destructive deletes/merges or provider calls at build time. Provider scopes, workspace access, plans, valid identifiers and relationships remain prerequisites. URLs in metadata are never fetched. API: https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/2.14/rest-api/api.intercom.io https://developers.intercom.com/docs/build-an-integration/learn-more/rest-apis https://developers.intercom.com/_bundle/docs/references/@2.14/rest-api/api.intercom.io.json?download=

definitions.name: Intercom create Article
definitions.documentation: Intercom API 2.14 POST /articles. Fixed documented regional HTTPS hosts, region US/EU/AU. Builtin config.$connection selects RuntimeConnection; profile.config merges with node config; bearer token comes from profile.credentials.accessToken or protected INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. Required numeric $retries=0. Requires request.confirmMutation=true. Requires request.confirmSend=true for customer-facing conversation/content action. One dispatch and one bounded page; cursor/page follow-up is explicit. Never retry uncertain writes. Known-field projection preserves optional/null/falsy values; resource IDs are opaque strings, numeric related admin IDs remain documented safe integers. Dot-only or ambiguous percent route fragments reject before credentials. Limits:100 results,100 nested items,100 custom attributes,256KiB request,1MiB response,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30,100000 values,total100–30000ms starting before profile/secrets and covering transport/decode/projection/cleanup. Fatal UTF8 and valid UTF16; no arbitrary endpoints/HTTP proxy, OAuth exchange/refresh, automatic pagination/retries, attachments, listeners, destructive deletes/merges or provider calls at build time. Provider scopes, workspace access, plans, valid identifiers and relationships remain prerequisites. URLs in metadata are never fetched. API: https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/2.14/rest-api/api.intercom.io https://developers.intercom.com/docs/build-an-integration/learn-more/rest-apis https://developers.intercom.com/_bundle/docs/references/@2.14/rest-api/api.intercom.io.json?download=
